about: The mutant ledger of internal/selfhostcheck and the self-hosting pilot it tests (testdata/selfhost): edits of the Go adapter and of the Ergo tree decoder that TestSelfhostBridgeAgrees, or the adapter's TestFamiliesCoverSyntax, must kill. scripts/mutants judges only check and lower today, and the pilot is a nested Go module; until it has a suite, a unit that changes these files applies each edit by hand and runs the killer (wf10 SH0).

mutants.name: sh-tree-drops-child
mutants.rule: Decode keeps every item of a list: a dropped child is a different tree.

mutants.name: sh-tree-loses-absent-pos
mutants.rule: An absent position (syntax.NoPos) is None, never offset 0.

mutants.name: sh-wire-replaces-invalid-byte
mutants.to: func str(s string) string  { s = strings.ToValidUTF8(s, "\uFFFD"); return
mutants.rule: The wire carries every string byte for byte, invalid UTF-8 included.

mutants.name: sh-tree-column-off-by-one
mutants.rule: Locate counts the line and the byte column from 1, as syntax.File.Position does.

mutants.name: sh-wire-drops-error-location
mutants.rule: A syntax failure crosses with its code, message, offset, length, line and column.

mutants.name: sh-family-table-misses-node
mutants.rule: The wire carries every node type of the syntax package; the corpus may not yet write a new one.
